Context: Honorarium

## Honorarium  
1. Definition.Remuneration for special work of an occasional or intermittent character paid to an employee from the Consolidated Fund of India/ State/ Union Territory.
2. Prior sanction necessary.Prior sanction of the Competent Authority is necessary before the work is undertaken. Amount of remuneration to be settled in advance.
3. (i) For any temporary increase in work, e.g., due conferences, etc., or for attending to duties of another
